en.title: Progress — {course}
en.nothing_yet: No pretest, post-quiz or review answers are logged yet.
en.gain_clause: your score went from {pre} before the note to {post} after it, a normalized gain of {gain}
en.retention_clause: a week later you kept {retention} of your post-quiz score
en.chart_alt: Progress chart: ○ pretest, ● post quiz, ◆ day-7 review, on one 0 to 100 scale
en.units_header: | unit | pre → post | gain | post → day 7 | retention |
en.scale_note: Scores run from 0 to 100. Gain and retention compare only the concepts attempted in both phases, and the means beside them are over those concepts.
en.partial_note: A phase shown as "k of n" is partial: k of its n tracked concepts have an attempt so far, and it stays out of every mean, gain and retention until the rest are answered.
